104. (1) A person who offers to a public official or any
other person, directly or indirectly any gratification in order
to influence such public official or other person with a view
to obtaining from the Government any benefit or service for
himself or any other person commits the offence of bribery
and on conviction be liable to a fine not exceeding one million
rupees and to a term of rigorous imprisonment not exceeding
seven years.
(2) A public official or any other person who, directly or
indirectly, solicits or accepts any gratification as is referred
to in subsection (1) commits an offence of bribery and on
conviction  be  liable  to  a  fine  not  exceeding  one  million
rupees and to a term of rigorous imprisonment not exceeding
seven years.
